findings.title: Prevent Enabled from panicking when Default is nil.
findings.rationale: Default is an exported *Set, so callers can assign nil. A later call to Enabled then dereferences nil through Default.Enabled(name) and panics. Keep the default set unexported, or provide a setter that rejects nil and controls concurrent replacement.
